review: W10 actual-route operation acceptance oracle preparation
scope: Prepared a frozen 16-case acceptance oracle and a VM harness that will call bounded actual pro-AI ask/runTurn/runTurn2/finish/finishCore/previewOptions/makeTools/onEvent/Cancel/doUndo functions. No production source was edited. No provider, native UI, server, or mirror calls were made.

frozen_source.freeze_boundary: Oracle and source assertion pinned before root operation-manager integration.
frozen_source.post-freeze_drift: Parent reported external copilot edits after the freeze. Latest read-only hash observed during preparation: 588A6120301F5009C3AC5C2249421B50D7BF6C1493D1356C8C002601FC996AC6. The parent also reported an intermediate 470F2A… state. No behavioral test was run against either moving post-freeze source.

cases: synchronous provider throw releases busy/controller state
Cancel with provider ignoring AbortSignal discards late success
Cancel A, start B, late A result cannot apply or clear B
late A progress event cannot overwrite B state
late A tool callback cannot append/apply after B
late A rejection cleanup cannot clear B
ready A followed by ask B before finish A
same-path reload increments source generation and invalidates A
source switch during warm prevents provider call
source switch during preflight prevents provider call
source switch during ordinary option previews prevents preview/apply on the replacement source
same-source Cancel restores its own preview without overwriting a manual revision
manual layer revision conflict prevents stale apply
normal edit action followed by actual doUndo restores the fake pre-action state
public ask admits B after Cancel A while A remains unsettled
oracle.identity_inputs: Harness models the actual public controller shape `SPBSourceLoadTransaction.getGeneration/getCommittedPath/getCommittedFingerprint`, a stable image reference, paintCanvas width/height, and `_spbLayerRev`; it avoids synthetic docId identity. Those controller and canvas values are fake test fixtures, not evidence of native behavior.

harness.method: Extracts actual bounded source functions by stable function boundaries; fake provider promises expose their options, callbacks, and AbortSignal. Actual makeTools creates edit_layer callbacks. Fake applyQueue/preview/Undo effects mutate observable arrays and revisions; actual finish/options/Undo/cancel/event control flow decides whether those effects run.
harness.source_assertion: The test refuses to run if current js/spb-pro-ai.js does not match the frozen 115F… pre-integration hash. Update only this hash after root provides a candidate hash; do not weaken the ORACLE assertions.
harness.validation: `node --check tests/ai_operation_route_review_contract.cjs` passed. The behavior harness was intentionally not run because pro-AI source changed after the pinned freeze and the parent instructed waiting for a candidate hash.

integration_dependencies_for_root: At public ask entry, allocate an operation ticket before any warm/preflight await and capture source generation, image identity, committed path/fingerprint, paint dimensions, and layer/zone revision.
Before and after warm/preflight, verify the request ticket and document snapshot; do not enter provider work for a replaced source.

For each runTurn2/provider-tool collection—including repair turns—allocate a distinct collection generation. Bind tool descriptors/callbacks and progress events to that token; reject stale callbacks after Cancel, repair, or a newer ask.
On Cancel, revoke the current ticket and clear busy/controller state only if that ticket still owns the route. A late resolve/reject/finally from A must not change B state.
Catch synchronous AI.run throws as well as asynchronous provider and warm failures, settling busy/controller state for the owning request.

Immediately before finish/apply, completion text, and every option preview/restore, check that the operation remains current and that document/revision matches. Option restoration must only restore the preview owned by that operation on its original document/revision.
Preserve standard action and Undo semantics; one accepted action remains one undoable transaction.

historical_baselines_kept_separate.W10_lease_cancel_review: 7/10 at its frozen run; three failures concerned ignored-abort late apply, synchronous provider throw, and ordinary document switch.
historical_baselines_kept_separate.operation_primitive_review: Original primitive source 7/9; after root manager repair the restored frozen oracle passed 9/9, plus separately labeled path-only fail-closed observation and root collection-token regression. This is primitive-only evidence and does not count as route integration.

claims_not_made: No route behavioral pass/fail result is claimed for the moving 470F… or 588A… sources.

No native browser, provider, server, canvas, or live painter result is claimed.
